notes:
Account summary
- Existing Dedicated customer (GPU pool reserved) running steady production traffic. Primary ask is to make cost optimization actionable for their platform team during onboarding of new routes.
- They do not want "black box" recommendations. They want (1) a savings estimate they can defend internally, (2) explicit risk classification, (3) a way to prove who viewed optimization guidance (audit trail).

Current footprint / workload
- Workload: patient note summarization + internal doc Q&A + embeddings for retrieval.
- Mix: ~70% chat/summarization routes, ~30% embeddings; traffic is spiky during business hours.
- Latency sensitivity: product team targets p95 < 2.5s for chat; throughput is more important than absolute latency off-hours (batching acceptable with guardrails).

What they asked for (verbatim-ish from call)
- "Show me what to change, why, and the blast radius (route/model/region)."
- "Don’t just show a dollar number—show the basis and confidence."
- "High risk needs an explanation. If it’s high risk because we have no headroom, say that."

Console Suggestions beta fit
- Northwind is a good beta candidate because they already have Dedicated capacity + stable routes (helps with savings baseline) and a motivated platform team.
- Proposed initial scope: read-only Suggestions view for 1 production workspace + 1 region (US-East) to build trust, then expand.

Key requirements flagged by customer security/IT
- RBAC: restrict Suggestions view to Admin + Platform Eng group only.
- Audit logging: who accessed Suggestions and what recommendation IDs were viewed (at least read events).
- Data handling: ensure the view doesn’t expose cross-workspace usage patterns; customer specifically asked how multi-tenant isolation is handled.

Open questions (Redwood)
- Confirm if their token metering baselines are complete for all routes; if not, they’ll see "insufficient telemetry" and lose confidence.
- Confirm if they want savings expressed as $/1M tokens, monthly impact, or both. Early feedback: prefer both, plus a short note on assumptions.

Next steps (internal)
1) Chris Osei to coordinate allowlist + feature flag enablement for tenant/workspace (read-only beta).
2) Evan Scott to run 45-min enablement walkthrough; focus on interpreting risk + 'basis of estimate'.
3) Rachel Kim to set weekly 15-min feedback loop for 2 weeks; capture: trust signals, missing suggestions, and any mismatches vs realized savings.
4) If they hit 'insufficient data' state, route to Logan Wright/Nadia Rahman for telemetry freshness check.

Next steps (customer)
- Provide the workspace ID(s) + list of roles that should have access.
- Identify 2-3 target routes to validate suggestions against (one summarization, one doc Q&A, one embeddings).
- Agree on success criteria for the beta trial: at least 1 low-risk caching or batching suggestion that they would adopt after review.

Internal tags
- Expansion motion: Optimize visibility + governance features (audit logging) are key to renewal/upsell conversation for Q2.
- Watch-outs: customer will push back if estimates fluctuate week-to-week without an explicit explanation (telemetry window / baseline drift).
